The dedicated meaningful-backend regression independently verifies a real write/read roundtrip and foreign-candidate refusal, but does not discharge the remaining private tools.

candidate_id.current computes a length-framed digest of the six specified MCP source files. Supervisor defaults and the five named adapters use this identity; every matrix cell asserts equality with it.
round2_finding_reverification.limitation: This identifies six source files, not the complete source tree or loaded BEAM bytes. Source freshness observations do not establish reproducible source-to-BEAM correspondence.

Empty-secret, malformed-topic and foreign-reply-destination regressions passed. This does not establish live router delivery.

Catalog tests passed. Unavailable tools remain excluded from discovery while typed adapters can refuse them; this is not identical discovery/call availability.
The actual disposition-artifact regression passed, including the preserved hold. Artifact classification does not independently prove content incorporation or a fresh external-workspace census.
Protocol-conformance and documentation-truth suites passed. Live HTTPS serving was not exercised.

Round-2 formal observations are historical evidence only in this review. No fresh Lean, Quint, Gospel or Hermes execution is claimed.
